about_the_game:
Dragomir: The Dreaming

In the beginning, there was only the Breath… and from it, all realms were born.

Before stars lit the sky, the Great Winged Mother and Orrann, force of Light, shaped Dragomir from the void. A land where elements thrived, life stirred, and shadow waited. Out of a long-forgotten conflict, the Dytann—elemental wolves—were created to defend the fragile Dream. You are Rehocca, one such wolf, called to uncover ancient truths and confront a growing darkness.

In this old-school high fantasy adventure, the world is vast, beautiful, and alive with mystery. The Dreaming is just the beginning—a gateway into an epic yet to unfold.

But this is no passive tale. You will shape it.

Explore sprawling environments—from towering ruins and verdant glades to elemental caverns and skybridges.

Quest across branching storylines—meet ancient beings, aid struggling villages, and face corrupted foes.

Craft your survival—gather ingredients, prepare nourishing food, and create enchanted items.

Engage in combat, both melee and magical—master elemental strikes and defensive techniques as you battle shadow-touched creatures.

Solve jumping puzzles and uncover secret pathways where only the nimblest wolves may tread.

Collect lore fragments, rare artifacts, and in-game achievements that deepen your connection to the world’s history.

Level up Rehocca’s powers—unlock new abilities like higher level spells and crafting, and evolve your combat style.

Save your progress anytime, allowing for family-friendly play—perfect for casual exploration or deep, lore-driven sessions.

Every step uncovers lost memories, reshapes your path, and weaves you deeper into the Dreaming.

Dragomir: The Dreaming invites you to an experience of discovery, challenge, and wonder. As the first chapter of a greater saga, it offers both adventure and a beginning…

And now the Breath stirs again.

Will you answer the call?
